record.question: A powerful spyware named "Pegasus" that was used to infect the phones of many Indian human rights activists, lawyers and journalists through whatsapp originates from
record.explanation: Answer C: Israel. Pegasus was developed by the Israeli firm NSO Group; the Supreme Court of India describes it as spyware produced by an Israeli technology firm. Reference: https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2021/16884/16884_2021_1_1501_30827_Judgement_27-Oct-2021.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
